annotation.title_clean: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2025/679 of 8 April 2025 amending Implementing Decision (EU) 2021/1195 as regards harmonised standards for sterilization of medical devices
annotation.title_en: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2025/679 of 8 April 2025 amending Implementing Decision (EU) 2021/1195 as regards harmonised standards for sterilization of medical devices
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union
annotation.summary_en: EU Commission Implementing Decision adding harmonised standards EN 556-1:2024 and EN 556-2:2024 on sterilization of medical devices to the list supporting Regulation (EU) 2017/746 on in vitro diagnostic devices, conferring presumption of conformity. Unrelated to AI or robotics.
key_provisions_or_claims: Amends the Annex to Implementing Decision (EU) 2021/1195 by adding entries 16 and 17.
Publishes references of EN 556-1:2024 and EN 556-2:2024 on 'STERILE' medical devices.
Compliance confers presumption of conformity with Regulation (EU) 2017/746.
Enters into force on the day of publication in the Official Journal.
